rows.legal_issuer: Liquidia Corporation (registrant); Liquidia Technologies, Inc. (operating subsidiary and NDA holder)
rows.shares_source_note: PRE_REORG_PREDECESSOR_ENTITY_SHARES_PROXY: on 2020-11-18, Liquidia Technologies, Inc. (CIK 1330436) converted into a wholly-owned operating subsidiary of a new holding company, Liquidia Corporation (CIK 1819576), via a standard 1-for-1 holding-company reorganization (confirmed by SEC filings: POS AM/S-8 POS/8-K all dated 2020-11-18, a 25-NSE delisting notice for the predecessor, and the predecessor's own Form 15-12B filed 2020-11-30). The new CIK has no shares-outstanding XBRL fact filed before 2021-03-15 (its first 10-K), so the most recent point-in-time figure available before the 2020-11-25 event is the predecessor CIK's Q3 2020 10-Q, filed 2020-11-06, six days before the reorg. A full EDGAR filing sweep of the predecessor CIK between the 10-Q's 2020-11-02 record date and the 2020-11-25 event confirms no 424B/S-1/other dilutive offering occurred in that window (only Form 4 insider transactions and the reorg's own non-dilutive registration paperwork), so this figure is a reliable point-in-time proxy for the same underlying operating business under the new registrant.
rows.corporate_action_note: Raw (unadjusted) SIP daily bars are used throughout; any split/dividend action before the cutoff is inherently reflected as-traded and requires no separate adjustment for the floor check. The 2020-11-18 holding-company reorganization was a 1-for-1 share exchange with no economic or trading-continuity break (ticker LQDA carried over unchanged on Nasdaq).
rows.determination_sufficiency: All floor components pass with margin.
rows.market_data_retrieval_note: Alpaca SIP daily bars, adjustment=raw, via scripts/m7_lib_marketdata.py:run_universe_check (ticker/CIK=LQDA/1819576, cutoff=2020-11-24). Shares-outstanding sourced manually from the predecessor CIK per the shares_source_note above because the automated companyfacts lookup against the post-reorg CIK returns no pre-event figure.
